title: Layoffs & Lockouts: Impersonal Sentences in Labour News
grammar: Saying What Happened Without Naming the Doer
goal: I can analyze institutional labor policies, corporate restructuring, and formal employer demands (*munkaköri leírás, munkáltatói önkény, felmondási hullám*).
I can say what happened without naming who did it, as Hungarian news reports do (*háromszáz dolgozót bocsátottak el, a kapuk le vannak zárva*).
I can recognise heavy officialese (*kifizetésre kerültek*) and say it more simply.
